items.title: Bitcoin slips below $62,000 as ether hovers near $1,750
items.body: Fund outflows and weak sentiment keep pressure on the market; BTC is down more than 13% over seven days.

items.title: Spot bitcoin ETF outflows near $2.9B for November, Fear & Greed at 12
items.body: Daily market report: ETFs keep bleeding while the sentiment index sits in extreme fear.

items.title: Ethereum's Glamsterdam upgrade could slip to May 2027
items.body: Smart contract compatibility issues may push the next network upgrade back by several months.

items.title: Anthropic perps on Hyperliquid approach $1.6B in daily volume
items.body: The AI company's listing drove heavy trading in related crypto products, while IPO allocations on crypto platforms stayed small.

items.title: Fables airdrop claim closes today at 23:59 UTC
items.body: Last day to convert points and redeem PROLOGUE into FABLES. Unclaimed tokens will not be minted.

items.title: Bitcoin miners have sold nearly half their BTC reserves since January
items.body: Miners are funding AI data center expansion by drawing down their bitcoin holdings.

items.title: Kraken parent Payward to acquire Tribe Capital
items.body: The deal expands Kraken's push into private-market investment products.

items.title: Standard Chartered, StraitsX and OCBC complete tokenized deposit trial
items.body: The banks tested moving tokenized deposits between each other's systems.

items.title: Senators press Treasury on equal footing for stablecoin issuers
items.body: Lawmakers want GENIUS Act rules to treat bank and non-bank issuers the same way.

items.title: Binance wins $6.5B freezing order from Abu Dhabi court
items.body: The exchange is trying to recover stolen crypto through the court order.

items.title: Ondo launches tokenized Anthropic stock on IPO day
items.body: Crypto users get onchain exposure to the AI company's shares from day one of trading.

items.title: Treehouse Season 2 claim ends November 25
items.body: 23.1M TREE are up for grabs; eligible wallets must claim through the official portal before 07:00 UTC.
